title: The Science Policy Script, Revised
journal_type: Science & Technology Studies / social studies of science; interdisciplinary social-science journal
sociology_status: 接近社会学：STS / social studies of science，不是综合社会学期刊
method: 以瑞士为经验案例，用 postcolonial STS 视角检验传统 Science Policy script 的基础假设；属于概念—制度分析，而不是访谈型研究。
materials: 瑞士新的 international science policy instruments and measures，包括政策战略、立法、研究与创新政策工具、双边/国际协议、委员会与官方决定，尤其关注 financial resource allocation、international scientific cooperation 与 development cooperation 的制度分类。
question: How do new international science-policy instruments directed toward emerging and developing countries challenge the traditional assumptions of Science Policy?
relation: 最适合帮助我把项目的 category、funding、lead institution、administrative responsibility、access/evaluation 等制度安排当成社会学证据，而不是背景信息。
key_insight: 制度分类、行政边界和资源配置本身可以成为分析对象。
quotable_passages: 待读后填写：只记短引文、页码、用途。

title: A comparison of British and German parliamentary discourses on science diplomacy over time
journal_type: Interdisciplinary global policy / international relations journal
sociology_status: 否：跨学科 global policy 期刊，不是社会学专门期刊
method_original: “analysed all speeches using the software MAXQDA and a coding scheme”
method: 比较性 parliamentary discourse/content analysis。作者用 R 提取语料，用 MAXQDA 编码；同时使用 deductive codes 和 iterative inductive codes。
materials: 2014年2月至2022年12月德国 Bundestag 与英国 House of Commons 关于 science/research 与 Russia 的议会演讲。初始 corpus 470 篇，人工筛选后保留 72 篇：德国 38、英国 34；来源包括 ParlSpeech V2 和议会档案。
question: How do MPs of different political parties discuss science diplomacy over time, and did that discourse change after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine?
relation: 适合模仿“官方文本 + 时间变化”的纯 desk-research 设计，也展示了如何从大 corpus 筛到可人工编码的小 corpus。
key_insight: 如果我要研究政策叙事的变化，可直接借鉴 corpus construction + deductive/inductive coding 的流程。

title: Science diplomacy as a foreign policy tool for Turkey and the ramifications of collaboration with the EU
journal_type: Broad interdisciplinary humanities and social sciences journal
sociology_status: 不是社会学专刊，但 scope 明确包括 Sociology 与 Science, Technology & Society
method_original: “the qualitative content analysis method was employed”
method: 两阶段 qualitative content analysis：先汇集 primary/secondary sources，再按 actors/policies/institutions 与 EU–Turkey relations/Europeanization/SD 等类别系统分析。
materials: Primary sources 包括 reports、policy papers、EU official communications、directives、press releases、speeches；另用 World Bank/OECD 报告统计 R&D 指标，并以 books、journal articles、digital/printed documents 作 secondary sources。
question: How does science diplomacy help explain changes in Turkish STI policies since 2000, especially through engagement with EU science and research programmes?
relation: 最适合借鉴多来源 desk research 和 triangulation：一个国际科技合作过程可以由政策文件、新闻稿、国际组织报告和二手文献共同重建。
key_insight: 公开材料来源可以非常杂，但需要先定义 coding categories，再把不同来源纳入同一分析框架。

title: Lifting the smokescreen of science diplomacy: comparing the political instrumentation of science and innovation centres
journal_type: Broad interdisciplinary humanities and social sciences journal
sociology_status: 不是社会学专刊，但 scope 明确包括 Sociology 与 Science, Technology & Society
method: 德国与瑞士 science and innovation centres 的 qualitative comparative case study；结合 policy instrumentation lens，并对两类来源做 thematic analysis 与 triangulation。
materials: 两类主要数据：(1) 20 份公开 policy documents（如 governmental strategies、annual reports）加 2 篇 speeches；(2) 13 次 semi-structured expert interviews 和若干 oral communications。
question: How did science and innovation centres develop as policy instruments in Germany and Switzerland, and what political rationales shaped their instrumentation?
relation: 主题和 institutional-form 比较很接近我的项目，但它依赖访谈，因此更适合借鉴 case comparison、policy instrument 和变量选择，而不是照搬数据收集。
key_insight: 比较 institutional form 时可以看 governance structure、funding model、tasks、thematic focus、organizational setup 等。

authors: Emma Sabzalieva, Creso M. Sá, Magdalena Martinez & Nadiia Kachynska
title: Science Diplomacy Policy Processes in Comparative Perspective: The Use of Scientific Cooperation Agreements in Canada, India, Norway, and the UK
journal_type: Science & Technology Studies / social studies of science; interdisciplinary social-science journal
sociology_status: 接近社会学：STS / social studies of science，不是综合社会学期刊
method: 跨国 comparative case study；先 literature review 选择国家和项目，再用 purposive sampling 每国选 2 个 programme，并以 Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework 编码政策过程。
materials: 4 国 × 每国 2 个 programme，共 8 个 bilateral/multilateral scientific cooperation programmes/agreements；核心数据是 17 次 semi-structured expert interviews，另用 programme reports、presentations、websites 做 triangulation；共编码约 450 个 excerpts/quotes。
question: How do policy actors, agendas, problems and alternatives interact in the creation of scientific cooperation agreements as science-diplomacy policy instruments?
relation: 项目选择逻辑和 comparative programme design 很值得借鉴，但核心证据依赖访谈，因此不适合我直接复制；可借鉴 purposive sampling 和项目特征比较。
key_insight: 可以把“项目/协议”作为清晰的 policy instrument unit of analysis，并明确列出 case-selection criteria。

title: What Ever Happened to the EU’s ‘Science Diplomacy’? The Long Mission of Effective EU-Mediterranean Cooperation in Science and Research
sociology_status: 否：跨学科 regional studies / social-science journal，不是社会学专门期刊
method: 历史性 policy-document analysis，追踪 EU science policy 的 external dimension 与 science 进入 EU foreign-policy agenda 的过程；不以关键词“science diplomacy”本身为唯一检索目标，而是重建其政策含义。
materials: EU strategic policy documents：一侧是 internal science policy（尤其 Framework Programmes 等 multi-year science/research plans），另一侧是 EU Southern Neighbourhood foreign-policy documents；用来追踪 international dimension、science/research/innovation references 与政策工具的变化。
question: How have EU science policy and foreign policy interacted over time in the Southern Mediterranean, and did the rise of ‘science diplomacy’ bring substantively new approaches?
relation: 和我最朴素的问题非常接近：不是先假定 science 是外交工具，而是历史性地看 science policy 与 foreign policy 怎么互相进入。
key_insight: 可以把两个原本分开的 policy domains 沿时间并排追踪，再观察何时、如何发生连接。

authors: Michał Łuszczuk, Barbora Padrtová & Wojciech Szczerbowicz
title: Political dimension of Arctic research
sociology_status: 否：期刊本身是海洋科学期刊；该文使用社会科学方法
method: mixed-method document analysis：qualitative 部分为 discourse/predicate analysis，quantitative 部分用 AntConc，最后把两部分结果 merged and compared。
materials: 17 个欧洲国家（6 Arctic、11 non-Arctic）的 Arctic policy documents 和/或 Arctic research strategies；研究还把没有公开完整英文政策文件的国家纳入国家层比较。
question: What role does research play in Arctic-state policies, and how are science, politics and international scientific cooperation connected?
relation: 和我的 desk research 条件高度兼容。最值得借鉴的是把 scientific/political dimensions 从国家战略文本里操作化并比较。
key_insight: 它直接说明“science 和 politics 的关系”可以通过政策文本做经验研究，而不需要访谈。

title: Between global collaboration and national competition: Unraveling the many faces of Arctic science diplomacy
journal_type: Interdisciplinary polar studies journal (natural sciences + humanities/social sciences)
sociology_status: 否：polar studies 综合期刊，不是社会学专门期刊
method_original: “combination of automated and qualitative text analysis”
method: 两层设计：top-down 分析 national Arctic strategies；bottom-up 用两个 typical cases 做 in-depth exploratory case studies。两层都放入同一个 science-diplomacy matrix/framework。
materials: Top-down：18 国共 26 份 Arctic strategy documents（2009–2021），MAXQDA 搜索并编码 competition/collaboration、国家/组织等。Bottom-up：AEIASC 与 Svalbard research 两个案例，材料包括 legal documents、government statements、scholarly articles。
question: How do collaboration and competition coexist across different forms and levels of Arctic science diplomacy?
relation: 目前最像我可能采用的整体结构：政策文件提供 breadth，项目案例提供 depth；两层用同一套维度比较。
key_insight: 不是简单把 policy 和 cases 并列，而是用同一 analytical framework 把两层连接起来。

title: Science diplomacy at the intersection of S&T policies and foreign affairs: toward a typology of national approaches
journal_type: Science, technology and innovation policy / public policy journal
sociology_status: 否：science & public policy 期刊，不是社会学专门期刊
method_original: “published papers and semi-official documents” + “more than 80 semi-structured expert interviews”
method: 六国 comparative study，目标是建立 cross-national heuristics / typology；比较 objectives、priorities、programs、resources 与 organizational patterns。
materials: 法国、德国、日本、瑞士、英国、美国六国。文献材料包括 published papers 和 semi-official government/S&T-agency documents；但数据主体是 80+ 次 semi-structured expert interviews，地点包括 Beijing、Boston、Brasilia、Moscow、New Delhi、New York、São Paulo、Seoul、Washington DC。
question: Why, to what ends, and how do six countries engage in science diplomacy, and what characterizes their national approaches?
relation: 非常适合借鉴 typology 的逻辑和比较维度，但不适合直接复制数据结构，因为作者明确说 interviews 是数据的 bulk and backbone。
key_insight: 我的 project dataset 可以借鉴其 objectives / priorities / programs / resources / organizational patterns 比较逻辑，但应改造成纯 desk-research 版本。
